weapon.d:
Enables【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】. Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants【Truly Incited】,【Def Liberate】, and "reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special 'reduce damage by X%' skills by 50% (excluding area-of-effect Specials)" to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (including area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit initiates combat after moving to a different space, triggers the following effects depending on unit's equipped Special: if unit has an area-of-effect Special equipped, grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before Special triggers before combat; if unit has a Special that triggers when unit attacks (excluding area-of-effect Specials), grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before unit's first attack during combat (X = number of spaces from start position to end position; max 3).
【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit before the above, +1. (Max ４.)
【Truly Incited】
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat × 2 (max 8).
【Def Liberate】
Grants bonus to Def during combat = number of Bonus effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

If unit's Special is ready, before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 × (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
At the start of turn, grants【Gallop】to unit.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by 40% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit's area-of-effect Special triggered before this combat, unit's Special was ready at start of combat, or unit has triggered【Cadenza】, unit's first follow-up deals damage = 80% of unit's Def during combat.
After combat and after subsequent【Cadenza】combat, if unit's Special triggered before initial combat, enables【Cadenza】against any foe within a distance equal to the range of unit's area-of-effect Special (up to twice per turn; does not trigger after【Cadenza】if 【Cadenza】is used against foes outside the range of unit's area-of-effect Special).
After combat, if unit's Special triggered, grants "unit can move 1 extra space" and neutralizes Stall for allies on the map (excluding unit; that turn only; does not stack).
【Gallop】
Unit can move 2 extra spaces (that turn only; only highest value applied; does not stack).
【Cadenza】
After combat initiated by unit (after post-combat skills are triggered; before post-action skills and Canto are triggered; Penalty effects that last through unit's action are neutralized), unit can attack foe again once, within a specified distance, regardless of unit's Range.
Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe can counterattack regardless of unit's Range, unit's Range = foe's Range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe. Skill effect's Range is determined by unit's weapon's Range. Unit's space before movement and unit's remaining movement referenced by the skill remain the same as before Cadenza. Unit cannot move, use Style, or attack structures; unit's area-of-effect Specials cannot be triggered, and after-combat movement effects do not occur. If unit uses Cadenza on foe that is within range of another Cadenza effect, Cadenza is treated as if having been triggered, including the other effect. Only highest value applied; does not stack. Does not trigger when affected by effects of Foresight Snare or traps in Aether Raids. Cadenza can be used only once per turn for player team in Summoner Duels. Does not trigger in Pawns of Loki.

a.d: If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 1. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 1.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 3. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 2.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 5. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 3.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants Atk/Def+10 and an additional Atk/Def+X to unit (X = highest bonus on each stat between target and foes within 2 spaces of target; calculates each stat bonus independently) and unit deals +7 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and also, if unit initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's attacks by Y × 4 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Reduces damage by Y × 4 when foe's attack triggers foe's Special during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
(Y = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 3.)

b.d: If unit initiates combat against a foe that can counter and unit's HP ≤ 30%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit initiates combat against a foe that can counter and unit's HP ≤ 40%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit initiates combat against a foe that can counter and unit's HP ≤ 50%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

If unit's Spd ≥ 30 at start of battle, inflicts Atk/Def/Res-4 on foe, deals damage = 20% of unit's Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 20% of unit's Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and unit's next attack deals damage = 40% of foe's first-attack damage prior to reductions during combat (resets at end of combat; only highest value applied; does not stack), and also, if unit's Def > foe's Def, triggers 【Potent Follow X%】during combat (if unit cannot perform follow-up and attack twice, X = 100; otherwise, X = 50; "at start of battle" excludes increases to Spd granted after unit is deployed, such as Legendary Effects, Mythic Effects, Bonus Heroes, Great Talent, etc.)
【Potent Follow X%】
Triggers an additional follow-up attack immediately after unit's standard follow-up attack and deals damage = X% of unit's normal attack damage (if unit cannot make a follow-up attack, this effect triggers when the standard follow-up attack would occur; this effect is treated like a follow-up attack, so effects like "reduce damage by X%" still apply, but this effect is not affected by effects that prevent follow-ups or "attacks twice" effects; only highest value applied; does not stack).

c.d:
If unit's HP = 100%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

If unit's HP ≥ 50%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

If unit's HP ≥ 25%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

When Canto triggers, enables unit to use 【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 during combat and restores 7 HP after combat.
Unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.
